summary: 16-year-old hunter with severe back injury on the north side of Grouse Mountain (11,900 ft), unable to walk; all-night litter carry-out to Meadow Mountain and ambulance to Vail Valley Medical Center.
location: Grouse Mountain (north side, 11,900 ft), West Grouse Creek Trail / Minturn
responding_agency: Vail Mountain Rescue Group + Eagle River Fire Protection District (wildland crew) + Eagle County Paramedic Services
notes: Date approximate: VVP "Mountain Rescue — Piney River Ranch" narrative (posted Nov 2015) places the mission "in mid-October"; exact date unrecoverable (backfill runs 23/26). Vail Dispatch ~6 p.m.: 16 YOM hunter unable to walk with severe back injury; hunting party had hiked 6.8 mi up West Grouse Creek Trail from Minturn trailhead; location fixed via SPOT beacon + cell phone position. 11-person hasty team accessed via Beaver Creek Ski Area to ski patrol HQ. SAR paramedic, IV pain meds, hypothermia bag + litter with wheel. Subject's father joined the carry; second 7-person team joined ~3 a.m.; reached vehicles 7 a.m.; UTV to Meadow Mountain; ambulance to Vail Valley Medical Center; field team out 8:30 a.m.
